points.text:
$\text{H}_0$: Population mean (or $\mu$) in city same as for others

$\text{H}_1$: Population mean (or $\mu$) in city greater than for others
points.guidance:
If **(a)** two-tail:

$\text{H}_0$: Pop mean (or $\mu$) in city same as for others.

$\text{H}_1$: Pop mean (or $\mu$) in region different from others.

points.text: There is evidence that buildings are higher [on average].
points.guidance:
In context, not definite. No contradictions.

If **(a)** two-tail: There is no evidence that the [average] height of buildings is different.
